throughline.zh: 本週晶圓、封裝、工廠及伺服器供應鏈公布已實現產值、出口接單與新增投資審查，也有東南亞算力建置與電力網路合作的分期規劃。
throughline.en: This week brought realized manufacturing output, export orders, packaging investment approvals and phased plans for Asia-Pacific compute infrastructure and regional grid cooperation.

title.zh: 先進封裝、晶圓材料與工廠投資
title.en: Advanced packaging, fab materials and manufacturing investment

summary.zh: 景碩、矽品及旺矽此前公布載板與封裝測試擴充目標，科林研發、日月光福雷與漢測則有廠房及設備合作。11 月 20 日福懋科擬於斗六擴充 DDR4 與高階 IC 封測，近 111.9 億元屬投資審查通過的計畫。
summary.en: Earlier reports covered Kinsus, SPIL, WinWay, Lam, Forei and Hermes in substrate, packaging and equipment development. On November 20, Formosa Advanced Technologies received investment approval for a proposed DDR4 and advanced-IC test expansion in Douliu.

title.zh: 機櫃電源、液冷與資料中心開發
title.en: Rack power, liquid cooling and data-center development

summary.zh: 技嘉、光寶、貝爾威勒及 SC26 參展廠先前揭露電源、液冷與伺服器規格。雲豹能源 11 月 19 日說明台灣及亞太逾 300MW 的 AIDC 開發規劃，尚無逐站商轉證據。
summary.en: Gigabyte, Lite-On, Bellwether and SC26 exhibitors previously reported rack power, cooling and server specifications. J&V Energy described an Asia-Pacific AIDC development pipeline exceeding 300MW without site-by-site commissioning evidence.

title.zh: 製造產值、記憶體供應與外銷接單
title.en: Manufacturing output, memory supply and export orders

summary.zh: 模組廠與大聯大等業者公布記憶體供貨資訊，輝達第三季亦揭露資料中心營收。經濟部接續公布第三季製造業名目產值及 10 月外銷訂單，兩者口徑不同，並與明年展望分開。
summary.en: Memory suppliers and WPG reported supply conditions, and NVIDIA disclosed data-center sales. MOEA later published Q3 manufacturing output and October foreign-order data, which use different definitions and periods.

title.zh: 製程供電、儲能與工廠能源管理
title.en: Process power, storage and factory energy management

summary.zh: 燿華儲能、熙特爾 PCS 合作及台塑新智能微電網方案屬不同施工、合作與營運階段。和碩 11 月 20 日公布 70 家關鍵供應商無碳電力計畫結果，新加坡能源官員亦談及區域電網合作方向，尚無新輸電工程的確定採購額。
summary.en: Unitech storage, Xitel PCS plans and Formosa Smart Energy microgrids are at different stages. Pegatron disclosed a 70-supplier carbon-free electricity program, while Singapore described regional grid policy without new contracted transmission projects.

title.zh: 跨境晶片管制、工業系統驗證與政策
title.en: Cross-border chip controls and industrial system validation

summary.zh: BIS 先前發布的高階晶片規則已於 11 月 19 日生效，台積電 11 月 20 日確認將遵守適用規定，但未證實匿名消息的停單範圍。竹東 6G-FORMOSA 實驗網同日正式啟用，屬晶片、射頻和通訊設備驗測，商用規格仍待確立。
summary.en: The BIS advanced-chip rule took effect November 19; TSMC confirmed compliance on November 20 but did not verify anonymous claims about halted orders. The Zhudong 6G-FORMOSA network launched as a chip, RF and systems testbed rather than a commercial network.
